proposedScope: The 1619 Honden at Nikkō Futarasan. Take the adjacent lower enclosure and prayer hall into account as distinct mapped buildings.

quallaOriginal.author: Fg2
quallaOriginal.observations: The original uploader states that he took the photograph and released his rights. The depicted historic Honden is visible above the low vermilion enclosure. Sign text and other foreground content are outside the architectural model.

facts.note: The national registry describes the 1619 single-story five-by-five-bay Honden, hip-and-gable roof, front chidori gable and three-bay porch.
